summary: Full backend + frontend regression of Puff2Door new features: Mongo catalog/inventory, password auth enhancements (strength, remember-me, forgot/reset, brute-force lockout), Google Emergent auth (failure path + seeded session), Deal of the Day, shop filters, wishlist + restock alerts, admin panel (stats/products CRUD/image upload/orders status/alerts). Backend: 74/74 pytest tests pass (32 new tests in test_puff2door_full.py). Frontend: all specified flows verified end-to-end in Playwright (home deal banner, filters, wishlist, sold-out detail+alert, auth login/register/forgot-reset/google-callback-failure, admin dashboard/products/upload/orders/alerts/denial, guest checkout -> tracker, reviews, cart persistence). No functional defects found; only testability/polish gaps listed below.

minor.issue: Email/password login returns the JWT in the JSON body only and does not set the httpOnly session_token cookie (only /api/auth/google/session does). Playbook expects httpOnly cookies on login; token currently lives in localStorage (p2d_token) => XSS exposure. Functional but worth aligning.
Passwords are hashed with passlib pbkdf2_sha256 (hash prefix $pbkdf2-sha256$) instead of bcrypt ($2b$). Secure, but deviates from the auth playbook expectation.

allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject credentialed wildcard CORS; cookie-based Google session only works because the preview serves same-origin. Prefer explicit origin list.

Lockout is keyed on email only (no IP dimension), so an attacker can lock out a legitimate user's account (account-lockout DoS). Verified: after 5 wrong attempts the CORRECT password also returns 429.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid="shop-filters" is rendered twice (desktop aside + mobile panel), causing Playwright strict-mode violations. Suggest suffixing e.g. shop-filters-desktop / shop-filters-mobile.
No catch-all 404 route: unknown paths (e.g. /product/<slug>, /nonexistent) render header+footer with an empty body instead of a Not Found page.
The mobile 'Filters' button has no data-testid (found only by role/name).

issues: 'Live' badge still shown after an admin sets a manual status; timeline timestamps remain the simulated +30s/+90s/+180s offsets rather than the admin update time, which can look inconsistent (e.g. 'Out for Delivery 03:24 AM' completed before that time).

action_items: Optional: de-duplicate the shop-filters data-testid (desktop vs mobile) and add a testid to the mobile Filters toggle.
Optional: add a catch-all 404 route in App.js so unknown URLs don't render a blank page.
Consider setting the httpOnly session cookie for email/password login too, and tightening CORS allow_origins when allow_credentials=True.
Consider adding an IP dimension (or captcha) to the brute-force lockout so an attacker cannot lock a victim's account by email alone.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 936 lines and mixes auth, catalog, orders, admin and storage; split into routers (auth/products/orders/admin) for maintainability.

admin_update_product replaces the whole document with ProductInput ($set of every field) - any field not in ProductInput (e.g. rating, createdAt) is preserved only because it's not in the payload, but slug is never regenerated on rename; acceptable, just be aware slug drifts from name.
Order creation checks stock then decrements in a second pass without a transaction/atomic conditional update ($inc with stock>=qty filter); concurrent orders can oversell to negative stock.

Wishlist/cart PUT accept arbitrary client-supplied price/name (CartItem) - order totals are taken from the client payload (subtotal/total) and never recomputed server-side, so a crafted request could pay any amount. Server-side price recomputation is recommended.

Two earlier apparent failures were test-side: (a) missing data-testid on the header cart badge and on all checkout/review form fields (fixed by adding testids), (b) wrong URLs used by the test (/product/{slug} instead of /shop/{slug}, ?s= instead of ?search=).
